clips.title: The story
paras: Amberstill Ranch is a tranquil dwarven homestead nestled along the snowy roadway toward Loch Modan, directly north of Gol'Bolar Quarry. It serves as the primary breeding and training grounds for Ironforge's celebrated mountain rams. Adventurers visit the ranch to acquire hardy dwarven mounts, train in riding, or help the family defend their livestock from local predators.

Tucked against the crags of Dun Morogh, Amberstill Ranch is renowned throughout Khaz Modan for raising the sturdiest mountain rams in the Eastern Kingdoms. The Amberstill family manages the stables and paddocks, training these sure-footed beasts to navigate treacherous snowy passes and steep alpine cliffs. Outside of supplying riding mounts and domestic livestock, the family often contends with the savage fauna of the hills, particularly wandering wendigos drawn by the scent of fresh flock.
